label: preparing
what: They are jointly provisioning an eighteen-hundred civic supper in the great hall. I have been told about the supper, but not any special underlying purpose; a fortieth-service anniversary celebration is possible, not established. Innkeeper organizes financing and deliveries, baker supplies bread, and Freight holds commissioned loaves and offers repayment. Secretary coordinates attendance and hall arrangements; neighbour has helped fund loaves. Confirmed reports indicate 107 secured loaves and thirty more agreed on private credit, with sixty-three still unfunded. There is no direct evidence of a separate secret plan.
